# Tissue RNA-seq

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
resolve_project_dir <- function() {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE_DIR"),
    Sys.getenv("PROJECT_ROOT"),
    Sys.getenv("PWD"),
    getwd(),
    "."
  )

  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (nzchar(candidate) && dir.exists(candidate)) {
      return(normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
    }
  }

  for (root in c("/scratch", "/mnt", "/workspace", "/tmp")) {
    if (dir.exists(root)) {
      return(normalizePath(root, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
    }
  }

  normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  echo = TRUE
)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(tximeta)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})

wd <- resolve_project_dir()
output_dir <- file.path(wd, "results")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

checkpoint <- function(obj, name, dir_path = output_dir) {
  saveRDS(obj, file.path(dir_path, paste0(name, ".rds")))
  invisible(obj)
}
```

```{r metadata}
sample_table <- read_excel(file.path(wd, "HumanTissueSamples205.xlsx"))
sample_table <- as.data.frame(sample_table)

required_cols <- c("sampleID", "tissue")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(sample_table))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing required metadata columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

sample_table$sampleID <- as.character(sample_table$sampleID)
sample_table$tissue <- as.character(sample_table$tissue)

message("Samples: ", nrow(sample_table))
print(table(sample_table$tissue))
```

```{r quantify}
files <- file.path(wd, "tissue205quant", sample_table$sampleID, "quant.sf")
if (!all(file.exists(files))) {
  stop("Some quant files are missing. Check the sample identifiers and input path.")
}

coldata <- data.frame(
  files = files,
  names = sample_table$sampleID,
  sample_table,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

se <- tximeta(coldata)
gse <- summarizeToGene(se)
checkpoint(gse, "gse_before_DE")
```

```{r normalize-and-design}
# Convert character columns to factors consistently to avoid fragile manual boilerplate.
for (nm in names(colData(gse))) {
  if (is.character(colData(gse)[[nm]])) {
    colData(gse)[[nm]] <- factor(colData(gse)[[nm]])
  }
}

gse$tissue <- factor(gse$tissue)
gse$subject <- factor(gse$subject)

gdds <- DESeqDataSet(gse, design = ~ tissue)
gdds <- DESeq(gdds)
checkpoint(gdds, "gdds_all_tissues")
```

```{r tissue-results}
tissue_levels <- levels(colData(gse)$tissue)
if (length(tissue_levels) == 0L) {
  stop("No tissue levels were detected in the metadata.")
}

summarise_tissue_results <- function(dds, tissue_name, alpha = 0.05) {
  ref_level <- levels(colData(dds)$tissue)[1]
  contrast <- c("tissue", tissue_name, ref_level)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast, alpha = alpha)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$padj, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  res_df
}

res_by_tissue <- lapply(tissue_levels, function(t) summarise_tissue_results(gdds, t))
names(res_by_tissue) <- tissue_levels
checkpoint(res_by_tissue, "res_by_tissue")
```

```{r export}
for (tissue_name in names(res_by_tissue)) {
  out_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tissue_name)
  write.table(
    res_by_tissue[[tissue_name]],
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("results_", out_name, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE
  )
}

norm_counts <- counts(gdds, normalized = TRUE)
write.table(as.data.frame(norm_counts), file = file.path(output_dir, "NormCountdata_205Tissues.txt"), sep = "\t")
```

This version keeps the same biological workflow, but it is safer for repeated runs, easier to audit, and less brittle when executed headlessly because it centralizes the DESeq result extraction and saves intermediate data checkpoints.
